title: The Judgment and Restoration of David's Fallen Hut
description: Amos sees the Lord standing by the altar and proclaims an inevitable judgment over sinful Israel—no one can hide, neither in the realm of the dead, nor in heaven, on Carmel, or in the depths of the sea. Yet the house of Jacob will not be completely destroyed. On that day the Lord will raise up David's fallen hut, repair its breaches, and rebuild it as in days of old. He will turn the fortunes of his people, cause the mountains to drip sweet wine, and plant them in their own land so they will never again be uprooted.
